notes: Non-refundable application fee is $80; international credential evaluation fee of $100 applies to international credentials.

app_fee.value: A non-refundable application fee of $80 is required.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $80 (U.S. currency) is required to have your application reviewed.

fee_waiver.value: Financial hardship waivers are not granted; specific waivers available only for UIC alumni and select programs.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, financial hardship waivers for graduate and professional applications are not granted.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements are determined by each specific academic program.
gre_general.quote: These are determined by program. See the program's website for complete details. Program requirements may include (but are not limited to) items such as: GRE scores - use our Institutional Code 1851 to report your results

toefl_min.value: Minimum required score for iBT Internet-based TOEFL is 80.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum required scores are: iBT Internet-based TOEFL of 80, with subscores of Reading 19, Listening 17, Speaking 20, and Writing 21; IELTS of 6.5, with all four subscores of at least 6.0

ielts_min.value: Minimum required IELTS Academic overall band score is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum required scores are: iBT Internet-based TOEFL of 80, with subscores of Reading 19, Listening 17, Speaking 20, and Writing 21; IELTS of 6.5, with all four subscores of at least 6.0

english_waiver.value: Exemption granted for enrollment at an accredited U.S. institution for at least two years of full-time study.
english_waiver.quote: Enrollment at an accredited U.S. institution for at least two years of full-time, academic study.
